name: 6-methyl-2,3,4,5-tetrahydro-1H-azepino[4,5-b]indole
summary: PNU-22394, or PNU-22394A, also known as U-22394A, as well as 6-methyl-1,2,3,4,5,6-hexahydroazepino[4,5-b]indole, is a serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist of the ibogalog family which was studied as an appetite suppressant and antipsychotic but was never marketed. As an ibogalog, PNU-22394 is a cyclized tryptamine and a simplified ibogaine analogue.

pharmacology.text: PNU-22394 acts as a potent modulator of the serotonin 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT2C receptors. Its affinities (Ki), activational potencies (EC50), and efficacies (Emax) were respectively 19 nM and 67.2 nM (64%) at the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor, 28.5 nM and 71.3 nM (13%) at the serotonin 5-HT2B receptor, and 18.8 nM and 18.8 nM (83%) at the serotonin 5-HT2C receptor.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT2C receptor agonist; Non-hallucinogenic serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2B receptor weak partial agonist or antagonist
